title: RPHA 71 Pearl White

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Designed for high-mileage highway touring and demanding daily commutes, the HJC RPHA 71 Pearl White is designed for touring enthusiasts demanding whisper-quiet cabin acoustics and plush comfort. Built around a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell weighing 1432g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~85 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.06 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Premium sport-touring model with advanced shock resistance.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for touring with a slightly elongated fit; may feel tight on high cheekbones.

technical_analysis: Features Premium Integrated Matrix (P.I.M. Plus) carbon and carbon-glass hybrid fabric shell structure paired with RapidFire II visor replacement system with 2D flat race shield and dual locking mechanism. The interior utilizes ACS Advanced Channeling Ventilation System with Multicool anti-bacterial temperature-regulating interior with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the HJC RPHA 71 Pearl White: combining South Korea 🇰🇷 craftsmanship with RapidFire II visor replacement system with 2D flat race shield and dual locking mechanism and ACS Advanced Channeling Ventilation System with Multicool anti-bacterial temperature-regulating interior. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in HJC's Touring lineup, the RPHA 71 Pearl White brings South Korean engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The HJC RPHA 71 Pearl White represents HJC's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~85 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Touring helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the HJC RPHA 71 Pearl White delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
